description: Search Naver Shopping by keyword and collect product prices, ratings, reviews, sellers, delivery and variants.

includeAds.description: Keep sponsored product cards in the results. Ads take a large share of the up to 90 cards, so ads-off runs return the organic subset. Every record carries `isAd`.
includeAds.title: Include paid ads

maxItems.description: Total products to save across all keywords, after ad and price filtering (1–1000). The source still caps each keyword at 90 cards.
maxItems.title: Max products

maxPrice.description: Drop fetched products more expensive than this price in Korean Won. Applied after collection, to the products this run fetched.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (KRW)

minPrice.description: Drop fetched products cheaper than this price in Korean Won. Applied after collection, to the products this run fetched.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (KRW)

searchQueries.description: One Naver Shopping search per keyword, in Korean or English. Each keyword returns up to 90 product cards, including ads. Leave empty only when an old task supplies a single `keyword`.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sort.description: Order the products this run fetched. Naver's mobile page does not accept a server-side sort, so this is a local sort, not a re-query.
sort.title: Sort products

title: Naver Shopping Scraper Input
